text: とび　おりるのは　ちょっと　こわいけど…　マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは　はやく　かえれて　いいよ

structure.jp: とび　おりるのは　ちょっと　こわいけど…
structure.en: jumping down is a little scary, but...

structure.jp: マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは
structure.en: when you go back to Pallet Town

structure.jp: はやく　かえれて　いいよ
structure.en: it's nice that you can get back quickly

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. とび　おりるのは = 'jumping down is...'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かえる to かえれる gives the meaning 'can go back'. Here it is in the て-form, giving the reason for what follows: かえれて = 'being able to get back'.

patterns.name: 〜ていい
patterns.explanation: A て-form followed by いい here says that the thing is good or pleasing, not that it is allowed. はやく　かえれて　いい = 'it's nice that you can get back quickly'.
